TokenLifetime._comment: Not a secret. Records the operational expectation FR-016/Assumption 7 relies on: the Entra ID app registration (an external system, not this API) issues access tokens no longer-lived than this. This system performs no per-request token revocation checks, so a removed member retains access for up to this long after removal. Program.cs asserts at startup that this never silently exceeds 60 minutes.
